title: Salem’s Mission
text:
Inside the Salem studio, Chicago, Illinois.




Salem Custom Screen Printing is a small, faith-driven business creating custom apparel for individuals, churches, events, and youth camps.


Every shirt we print carries more than ink — it carries a message.

Whether it’s a fundraiser, a camp tee, or a gift, we’re here to help you share what matters most.


01

Rooted in faith
Salem is rooted in faith and a love for bringing people together.



02

Made with care
Every order is printed and packed with care in our small Chicago studio.



03

Made for your message
Individuals, churches, events, youth camps, fundraisers, and gifts. Whatever you have in mind, we’ll help you wear it with purpose.

title: Rooted Event
text:
Colossians 2:6–7
“As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk ye in him: rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith.”

Roots matter. Before anything can grow tall, it has to grow deep. That’s the heart behind Rooted, our pre-youth camp event based on Colossians 2:6–7, where we focused on staying grounded in Christ and being built up in our faith.





The Rooted tee, fresh off the press.




The shirt

Grow deep before you grow tall.
We designed and printed the Rooted tee as a reminder of the event’s theme, something to keep wearing long after camp.
